versions.changelog:
- Documentation updates only; no functional changes to the skill.
- SKILL.md reformatted or touched, but version and implementation remain unchanged.

Initial release of Seedance 2.0 Video Generation skill.

- Generate AI videos from text prompts, images (first frame or first + last frame), or combine for more control.
- Supports chaining segments for long videos (>15s) with last-frame continuity.
- Audio generation and draft mode (cheaper, faster previews) are available.
- Python CLI tool provided for robust task creation, polling, and downloads; raw API/curl guides included.
- Manage video generation tasks (create, check status, download result) via Volcengine Ark Seedance 2.0 model.
